scripts.bundle: read -p 'Enter bundle version, e.g. 22.22.22-work-conf-999: ' BUNDLE_VERSION && read -p 'Enter bundle out directory: ' BUNDLE_OUT && node ./tools/bundle.mjs $BUNDLE_VERSION $BUNDLE_OUT
scripts.release: npm run -C arkgen compile && npm run -C core compile && npm run -C linter compile && npm run -C arktscgen compile && npm run -C idlinter compile && node tools/release.mjs
scripts.sanity: npm run -C arkgen sanity && npm run -C linter run
